steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: It's all wrong. All wrong. Have to start over. Do a new round of calculations... Go back to Step 34. No, no... I keep going. I will prove it...

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: <size=30>We have seen stars that lie millions of light years away from my planet. Our shared memories, they pass on from generation to generation. What one generation learns is a foundation that the next can build on. Our efforts are not futile. What we believe in is not a pipe dream...</size>
She's losing her grip. Mud climbs up her body, enveloping it. You see tears rolling down her cheeks. Those tears represent the last residues of her humanity.
You hear no response. Her insubstantial figure is all but entirely consumed. A shadow monster slowly wrapped itself around the thin figure of the scholar.
